findings.claim: The change declares no touch-point list (no spec under docs/specs/ and no invariants.md for topic feature-design-conformance-check), so both places it reaches, the new .claude/agents/design-checker.md and the new review rule in docs/process/PROJECT.md:72-86, are outside any declared touch-point list.
findings.impact: No user-facing behavior is affected; the change is docs/process only. A reader cannot check the scope against a plan, and future reviews have no invariant to hold the new design-check rule to.
findings.evidence: Grep for 'design-check|design-checker|conformance' finds only PROJECT.md, the new agent file and earlier review records; docs/process/reviews/feature-design-conformance-check/ contains only r1/ (head.txt, expected.txt, classification.json, fixes.txt), with no spec or invariants.md. classification.json lists zones_touched .claude/agents/design-checker.md and docs/process/PROJECT.md, docs_only true.

bucket_proposal.reason: No declared invariant exists to break; this is a process/scope gap in a docs-only change, not a defect a user can hit.

findings.proposed_fix: Either add a short spec with ## Touch points listing these two files, or accept the docs-only change without a spec explicitly in decisions.md.

specification_compliance: No spec or invariants file exists for this change, so there is no touch-point list to compare against; every reached place is therefore undeclared (CR-1).
The change touches only .claude/agents/design-checker.md (new) and docs/process/PROJECT.md (lines 72-86); no code, tests, gates or CI files are touched.
potential_unspecified_behavior: PROJECT.md:80-81 now requires R-5 to screenshot every artboard at the artboard's width plus the phone width, but .claude/agents/r5-runner.md, the agent that performs R-5, was not updated and gives no such instruction; this is a place the diff does not reach rather than an extra place it reaches.
regression_risks: The ship rule in PROJECT.md:84-86 (no ship while a D- finding is neither fixed nor accepted in decisions.md) is prose only; nothing in review.sh, precheck or CI checks for design-check.md or D- acceptance, so a change can still ship with unresolved D- findings unnoticed.
r5-runner.md was not updated to take the artboard-width screenshots, so design-checker may report many 'not shown in R-5' findings until it is.
test_coverage: Docs-only change; no tests apply and none were added. No gate enforces the new design-check step.
not_verified: Did not read scripts/process/review.sh or process/process.conf to confirm none of them reference design-check.md or need updating.
Did not read docs/process/workflow.md R-5 section to check consistency with the new screenshot requirement.
Did not check whether any harness hook restricts the design-checker agent's Write tool to the review directory.
